newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Corp A falls 6.67 pct in mid-trade.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Corp A falls 6.67 pct in mid-trade.

text.p: Conglomerate Ayala Corp dropped 1.25 pesos, or 6.67 percent, to 17.50 pesos at midsession on Wednesday on a wave of selling that struck the local equities market, brokers said.

"It's because of the general profit-taking. I cannot pinpoint any negative issues related to Ayala except that concerns are still up in the air regarding the glut in the high-end property sector," said Dennis Rayala, head of research at Abacus Securities Corp.
Ayala Corp is the parent firm of real estate firm Ayala Land Inc which has been battered by concerns of a meltdown in the property sector.
The B shares of Ayala Corp were also down, losing one peso, or 5.41 percent, to 17.50 pesos. It was the tenth most heavily traded stock in mid-session. Ayala Land slipped 50 centavos to 19 pesos.
